name: sample a large dataset from the intervened model and persist it
definition: draw a fixed number of rows from the intervened joint over the original columns and write a CSV preserving the original column names.
failure_mode: wrong column count/names or non-parametric samples fail the checks

name: save dag edges as a from,to csv file
definition: write directed edge records as a two-column CSV with the required header and each parental relation oriented correctly.
failure_mode: missing headers or swapped endpoints fail the structural checks
